1.2 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 10% normal goat serum (NGS) in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Primary Antibody Staining  
2.1 Incubation with Brn3a/POU4F1 primary antibody (1:200 dilution in 1% NGS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with RBPMS primary antibody (1:200 dilution in 1% NGS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000 dilution in PBS) for 30 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

3 Washing  
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Repeat step 3.1 three times (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

4 Secondary Antibody Staining  
4.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:200 dilution in 1% NGS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated secondary antibody (1:200 dilution in 1% NGS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Washing  
5.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Repeat step 5.1 three times (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

6 Dehydration  
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Delipidation  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Clearing  
8.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (1:1 mix of dibenzyl ether (DBE) and DCM) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

9.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (e.g., 1.51 RI oil or custom refractive index matching medium) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

10 Imaging Preparation  
10.1 Mount the cleared eye in RI-matching medium using a low-viscosity mounting medium suitable for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.  
10.2 Ensure the sample is fully immersed in RI-matching medium to minimize optical distortion during imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling

1.4 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-RBPMS (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS-T (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.6 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.7 Wash with PBS-T for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.8 Incubation with biotinylated Lectin (1:100 dilution in PBS) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.9 Wash with PBS for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.10 Incubation with streptavidin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500 dilution in PBS) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.11 Wash with PBS for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution 1 (10% (vol/vol) DCM, 10% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 80% (vol/vol) PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution 2 (20% (vol/vol) DCM, 20% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 60% (vol/vol) PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution 3 (30% (vol/vol) DCM, 30% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 40% (vol/vol) PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.4 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution 4 (40% (vol/vol) DCM, 40% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 20% (vol/vol) PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.5 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution 5 (50% (vol/vol) DCM, 50% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI-matching solution (50% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 50% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Store the cleared eye in RI-matching solution at 4 ℃ until imaging.  
6.2 For long-term storage, transfer to a sealed container with RI-matching solution and store at 4 ℃.  
6.3 Use light-sheet or confocal microscopy for imaging, ensuring appropriate excitation wavelengths for Alexa Fluor 568 and 647.

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [F-Actin + Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568, Ki67 + Anti-Ki67 (Abcam ab15580) + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its strong clearing power and ability to penetrate dense tissue, which is essential for the relatively large and complex human brain organoids. It allows deep antibody penetration and is compatible with a wide range of fluorophores, including Alexa Fluor 488 and 568, which are used here for labeling Ki67 and F-Actin, respectively. DAPI was removed due to incompatibility with the chosen method and labeling targets. The combination of F-Actin (for structural integrity) and Ki67 (for proliferation assessment) provides comprehensive data on organoid growth, structure, and drug-induced changes.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 24 hours at 4 ℃ (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with Ki67 primary antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours at 4 ℃ (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours at 4 ℃ (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 F-Actin Staining  
3.1 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:100 dilution in PBS) for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Dehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Delipidation  
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butyl alcohol for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

6 Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (1:1 mix of 100% tert-butyl alcohol and 100% dibenzyl ether) for 12 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution for an additional 12 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1:1 mix of 100% dibenzyl ether and 100% n-propylbenzene) for 12 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution for an additional 12 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

8 Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Store organoids in RI-matching solution at 4 ℃ until imaging.  
8.2 For light-sheet microscopy, ensure complete immersion in RI-matching solution and use appropriate filter sets for Alexa Fluor 488 and 568.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [RBPMS + Alexa Fluor 488, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its strong clearing power and deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, which is essential for thick, dense tissues like the whole mouse eye. It effectively reduces RPE pigment interference by removing lipids and pigments, enabling deeper imaging of retinal layers. The use of RBPMS (a specific marker for retinal ganglion cells) with Alexa Fluor 488 and CD31 (a specific vascular endothelial marker) with Alexa Fluor 647 ensures dual-channel detection of retinal ganglion cells and vascular networks with minimal background interference. This method also avoids quenching of exogenous fluorophores, allowing for high-resolution 3D imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum in PBS to block non-specific binding for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Primary Antibody Staining  
2.1 Incubation with anti-RBPMS antibody (1:200 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with anti-CD31 antibody (1:200 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Washing  
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Repeat step 3.1 three times (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

4 Secondary Antibody Staining  
4.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Washing  
5.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Repeat step 5.1 three times (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

6 Dehydration  
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Delipidation  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Clearing  
8.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (1:1 mix of dibenzyl ether (DBE) and DCM) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 50% (vol/vol) glycerol in DBE) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

10 Imaging Preparation  
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) RI-matching solution for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
10.2 Mounting in RI-matching solution for light-sheet or confocal imaging.

1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.5 Wash with PBS-T (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.6 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.7 Wash with PBS-T for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.8 Incubation with Lectin (1:100 dilution in PBS) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.9 Wash with PBS for 3 times, 15 minutes each (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.3 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.51) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is well-established for clearing dense human clinical tissue blocks and provides strong clearing power with good dye penetration, which is essential for visualizing fine structures like IENF in thick skin samples. It is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 (used for PGP9.5 immunostaining). The method’s high refractive index matching ensures minimal light scattering during imaging, enabling high-resolution 3D reconstruction of IENF distribution.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Immunostaining  
1.1 Incubation with 10% normal goat serum in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibody against PGP9.5 (1:500 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 μg/mL in PBS) for 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.7 Wash with PBS for 3 × 5 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes each)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibromoethane (DBE) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) DBE) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) DBE) for an additional 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 50% (vol/vol) glycerol in DBE) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) for an additional 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mount the cleared tissue in RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) on a glass-bottomed dish for imaging.  
6.2 Ensure the sample is fully immersed in RI-matching solution to minimize light scattering and optimize optical clarity for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Ki67 (MKI67)+Alexa Fluor 488, PCNA+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method with strong clearing power suitable for dense or lipid-rich tissues like brain organoids. It allows deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, which is essential for labeling nuclear markers such as Ki67 and PCNA in thick 3D samples. The method preserves fluorescence compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes, which are ideal for detecting cell cycle and DNA replication markers. DAPI was removed due to its incompatibility with the chosen markers and fluorophores.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Washing with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.3 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Washing with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.5 Incubation with Ki67 antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.6 Washing with PBS-T (0.1% Triton X-100) for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.7 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.8 Washing with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.9 Incubation with PCNA antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.10 Washing with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.11 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.12 Washing with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibromoethane (DBE) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with FDISCO R1 (40 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.48) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with FDISCO R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.51) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Incubation with FDISCO R3 (40 vol% MXDA, 70% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.53) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with FDISCO R4 (40 vol% MXDA, 90% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.54) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with FDISCO R5 (40 vol% MXDA, 100% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.55) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** MACS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** MACS is an aqueous clearing method that preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins and allows deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, which is essential for thick and dense human skin tissue. It avoids the use of hazardous organic solvents, ensuring safer handling in a clinical setting. The labeling strategy uses PGP9.5 (a specific marker for IENF) with Alexa Fluor 488 and CD31 (a specific vascular endothelial marker) with Alexa Fluor 647, both of which are compatible with MACS. Lectin was excluded due to marker-level cautions indicating compatibility issues with MACS. This combination enables high-resolution visualization of both IENF and superficial dermal vasculature while preserving tissue morphology.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Fixation  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Washing with PBS for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Washing with PBS for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  
2.3 Incubation with 10% normal goat serum (NGS) in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Immunostaining  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-PGP9.5 (1:500 dilution in PBS + 1% NGS), anti-CD31 (1:200 dilution in PBS + 1% NGS) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.2 Washing with PBS for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.4 Washing with PBS for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

4 Tissue Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with MACS-R0 (20 vol% MXDA, 15% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.40) for 36 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with MACS-R1 (40 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.48) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.51) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with MACS-R3 (40 vol% MXDA, 70% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.52) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mounting the cleared tissue in MACS-R3 on a glass-bottom dish for imaging.  
6.2 Ensure the refractive index of the mounting medium matches that of MACS-R3 (RI = 1.52) to minimize light scattering during imaging.

**Chosen Labeling:** [Ki67 (MKI67)+Alexa Fluor 488, PCNA+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method that provides strong clearing power for dense tissues like brain organoids while preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins and allowing deep penetration of exogenous dyes. It is faster than aqueous methods and compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and 647, which are ideal for dual labeling of Ki67 and PCNA to assess proliferation. DAPI is not used as it is a nuclear counterstain and not target-specific labeling. This protocol minimizes tissue distortion and supports high-throughput screening by enabling rapid processing and compatibility with light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.3 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.5 Incubation with Ki67 antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.6 Wash with PBS-T (0.1% Tween-20) for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.7 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Wash with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.9 Incubation with PCNA antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.10 Wash with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.11 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.12 Wash with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Ki67 (MKI67)+Alexa Fluor 488, PCNA+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method that provides strong clearing power for dense tissues like brain organoids while preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins and allowing deep penetration of exogenous dyes. It is faster than aqueous methods and compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and 647, which are ideal for dual labeling of Ki67 and PCNA to assess proliferation. DAPI is used as a nuclear counterstain for structural reference. This protocol minimizes tissue distortion and supports high-throughput screening by enabling rapid processing and compatibility with light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.3 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.5 Incubation with Ki67 antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.6 Wash with PBS-T (0.1% Tween-20) for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.7 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Wash with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.9 Incubation with PCNA antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking buffer) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.10 Wash with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.11 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking buffer) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.12 Wash with PBS-T for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.13 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000 dilution in PBS) for 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.14 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

2 Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Delipidation
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Clearing
4.1 Incubation with FDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE)) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with FDISCO clearing solution (100% DBE) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 50% (vol/vol) sorbitol in DBE) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Imaging Preparation
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** MACS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP, mCherry/RFP]  
**Justification:** MACS is an aqueous clearing method that preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins such as EGFP and mCherry/RFP, which are already present in the sample. It provides good penetration of fluorescent signals and maintains tissue morphology, making it ideal for visualizing the 3D structure of the C. elegans nervous system, including the nerve ring, neuronal somata, neurites, and major nerve bundles. The method is well-established for small whole-body samples like C. elegans and avoids the use of organic solvents that could quench the fluorescent signals.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with MACS-R0 (20 vol% MXDA, 15% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.40) (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with MACS-R1 (40 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.48) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.51) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Refractive Index Matching  
2.1 Incubation with MACS-R3 (40 vol% MXDA, 70% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.52) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with MACS-R4 (40 vol% MXDA, 90% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.53) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Sample Storage and Imaging Preparation  
3.1 Transfer cleared samples to a refractive index-matched solution (MACS-R4) for long-term storage at 4 ℃.  
3.2 Prior to imaging, ensure the sample is fully immersed in MACS-R4 and placed in a low-RI mounting medium compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy.  
3.3 Perform imaging using a confocal or light-sheet microscope equipped with appropriate excitation/emission filters for EGFP (488 nm/520 nm) and mCherry/RFP (561 nm/610 nm).

**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is well-suited for high-lipid or high-pigment-rich tissues like skin biopsies due to its strong clearing power and deep penetration of antibodies and dyes. It allows for robust labeling of IENF with PGP9.5 (a specific marker for intraepidermal nerve fibers) and CD31 for vascular networks. The method is compatible with the selected fluorophores and supports high-resolution 3D imaging of thick tissue sections.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 0.1 M phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 0.1 M phosphate buffer containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum in PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-PGP9.5 (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-CD31 (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.4 Washing with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution in PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.6 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG (1:500 dilution in PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.7 Washing with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 1 (10% (vol/vol) DCM, 10% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 80% (vol/vol) PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 2 (20% (vol/vol) DCM, 20% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 60% (vol/vol) PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 3 (30% (vol/vol) DCM, 30% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 40% (vol/vol) PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.4 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 4 (40% (vol/vol) DCM, 40% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol, 20% (vol/vol) PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.5 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 5 (50% (vol/vol) DCM, 50% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., dibenzyl ether or custom RI-matching medium) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7.1 Mounting the cleared tissue in RI-matched medium using a coverslip or glass-bottom dish suitable for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP, mCherry]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous clearing method specifically suited for small whole samples like C. elegans, preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins (EGFP and mCherry) without quenching. It supports deep penetration of dyes and antibodies, which is essential for visualizing fine neural structures such as the nerve ring, head neurons, and ventral nerve cord. The method also maintains morphology with minimal shrinkage or distortion, ensuring accurate 3D spatial relationships between neural structures. Since the sample already expresses EGFP and mCherry reporters, no additional labeling is required beyond ensuring their preservation during clearing.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Washing with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)  

2 Clearing Solution Incubation  
2.1 Incubation with Ce3D solution A (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with Ce3D solution B (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 10% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with Ce3D solution C (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 20% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Refractive Index Matching  
3.1 Incubation with Ce3D solution D (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 30% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with Ce3D solution E (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 50% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with Ce3D solution F (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 70% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Final RI Matching and Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Incubation with Ce3D solution G (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 90% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with Ce3D solution H (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 95% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with Ce3D solution I (1.5 M urea, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1% SDS, 100% w/v sucrose) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Post-Clearing Storage and Imaging  
5.1 Transfer to a refractive index-matched mounting medium (e.g., 1.51 RI glycerol-based medium) for imaging (Temperature: RT, Time: as needed)  
5.2 Store at 4°C in the mounting medium if not imaged immediately (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 1 week)

The aqueous nature of TDE avoids quenching of fluorescent proteins, making it ideal for this application.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration

2 Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) TDE reagent (containing 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 10% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) SDS, 10% (vol/vol) urea, 10% (vol/vol) glycerol, 10% (vol/vol) PVA, 10% (vol/vol) sorbitol, 10% (vol/vol) NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) Tris-HCl, pH 8.0) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 75% (vol/vol) TDE reagent (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) TDE reagent (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Refractive Index Matching  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) TDE reagent (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) TDE reagent + 0.1 µg/mL SCRI Renaissance 2200 (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) TDE reagent + 0.1 µg/mL SCRI Renaissance 2200 (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) TDE reagent (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Mount sample in TDE reagent on a glass slide with a coverslip for imaging.

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin (F-actin), Myosin VIIa antibody + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous clearing method well-suited for small whole-body samples like 5 dpf zebrafish larvae. It preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins and supports deep penetration of dyes and antibodies, which is essential for labeling both F-actin with Phalloidin and Myosin VIIa (a specific marker for lateral line hair cells). The method also minimizes tissue shrinkage and distortion, preserving the morphology of delicate structures such as the stereocilia bundles and apical actin-rich domains.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody against Myosin VIIa (1:200 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 2 days (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with PBS + 1% BSA for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG, 1:500 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 1 day (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with PBS + 1% BSA for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Phalloidin Staining  
3.1 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100 dilution in PBS with 1% BSA) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with PBS + 1% BSA for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Tissue Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with Ce3D-R1 (10 vol% MXDA, 10% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.42) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with Ce3D-R2 (20 vol% MXDA, 20% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.45) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with Ce3D-R3 (30 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.48) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with Ce3D-R4 (40 vol% MXDA, 40% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI = 1.51) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Incubation with 1x PBS containing 0.01% NaN3 to prevent microbial growth (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Mounting in a refractive index-matched medium (Ce3D-R4) on a glass-bottom dish for imaging (Temperature: RT, Time: immediately)

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin (F-actin/静纤毛束), Myosin VIIa (毛细胞身份确认)]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous clearing method well-suited for small whole-body samples like 5 dpf zebrafish larvae. It preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins and supports deep penetration of dyes and antibodies, which is essential for labeling both F-actin (via Phalloidin) and Myosin VIIa (a specific marker for hair cells). The method also minimizes tissue shrinkage and distortion, preserving the morphology of the lateral line system for accurate analysis of hair cell distribution and structure.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Washing with PBS for 3 × 10 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each)  
1.3 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum + 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with primary antibody against Myosin VIIa (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 2 days (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Washing with PBS + 0.3% Triton X-100 for 3 × 10 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each)  
1.6 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.7 Washing with PBS + 0.3% Triton X-100 for 3 × 10 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each)  
1.8 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100 dilution in PBS) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.9 Washing with PBS for 3 × 10 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with Ce3D-R1 (15% w/v sorbitol, 20 vol% MXDA, RI = 1.40) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with Ce3D-R2 (30% w/v sorbitol, 40 vol% MXDA, RI = 1.48) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with Ce3D-R3 (50% w/v sorbitol, 40 vol% MXDA, RI = 1.51) for 2 days (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (Ce3D-R3) for 1 day (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mounting in RI-matching solution (Ce3D-R3) on a glass-bottomed dish for imaging (Temperature: RT, Time: as needed)

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa (anti-Myosin VIIa antibody, Alexa Fluor 488), Phalloidin (Alexa Fluor 568)]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous clearing method that preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins and supports deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, which is essential for labeling specific markers like Myosin VIIa and F-actin with Phalloidin in intact 5 dpf zebrafish larvae. It also minimizes tissue deformation, addressing the issue of severe swelling observed with ScaleS protocols. The use of Alexa Fluor 488 and 568 ensures compatibility with Ce3D and provides strong fluorescence retention for high-resolution 3D imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 1 (20% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 2 (30% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 3 (40% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody (anti-Myosin VIIa, 1:200 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG, 1:500 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes)  

3 F-Actin Staining  
3.1 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:100 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (Ce3D Reagent 4: 50% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Incubation with mounting medium (RI-matched to Ce3D Reagent 4, e.g., 50% w/v sucrose in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Mounting on a glass slide with a coverslip for light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin (F-actin, Alexa Fluor 488), Myosin VIIa (anti-Myosin VIIa antibody, Alexa Fluor 647)]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous clearing method well-suited for small whole-body samples like 5 dpf zebrafish larvae. It preserves endogenous fluorescent proteins and supports deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, which is essential for labeling both F-actin in hair cells and Myosin VIIa in lateral line neuromasts. The method also minimizes tissue shrinkage and distortion, preserving the 3D spatial relationship between hair cells and lateral line nerves. Phalloidin directly labels F-actin in stereocilia, while anti-Myosin VIIa antibody specifically marks hair cells, ensuring accurate visualization of the target structures.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100 dilution in PBS) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
2.3 Incubation with anti-Myosin VIIa antibody (1:200 dilution in PBS) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
2.5 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:200 dilution in PBS) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

3 Tissue Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 1 (10% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Tween-20 in PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 2 (20% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Tween-20 in PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 3 (30% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Tween-20 in PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 4 (100% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Tween-20 in PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 5 (100% w/v sucrose, 0.1% v/v Tween-20 in PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with Ce3D Reagent 6 (1.51 RI matching solution) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mount the cleared sample in a glass-bottomed dish filled with Ce3D Reagent 6 (RI = 1.51)  
5.2 Ensure no air bubbles are present under the sample  
5.3 Proceed to imaging using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission settings for Alexa Fluor 488 and 647

**Chosen Method:** TDE  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, YFP, SCRI Renaissance 2200]  
**Justification:** TDE is an established clearing method for plant tissues like *Arabidopsis* whole seedlings, preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins (GFP/YFP) and allowing deep penetration of cell wall markers such as SCRI Renaissance 2200. It is aqueous-based, non-toxic, and compatible with the fluorescence signals required for observing both transgenic reporter expression and cell wall architecture. This method ensures minimal tissue shrinkage and maintains structural integrity, which is critical for analyzing root architecture and tissue organization in intact seedlings.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Cell Wall Staining  
2.1 Incubation with 1 µg/mL SCRI Renaissance 2200 in 40% (vol/vol) sucrose solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Wash with 40% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Wash with 30% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Wash with 20% (vol/vol) sucrose in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with TDE reagent (1.5 M urea, 0.5 M NaCl, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh TDE reagent (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 80% (vol/vol) glycerol in TDE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with final RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 90% (vol/vol) glycerol in TDE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mount the cleared sample in a glass-bottom dish filled with final RI-matching solution (1.51 RI)  
5.2 Cover with a coverslip and seal with nail polish or vacuum grease to prevent evaporation  
5.3 Perform imaging using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission settings for GFP, YFP, and SCRI Renaissance 2200 (excitation: 488 nm for GFP/YFP; 633 nm for SCRI Renaissance 2200)

Although TDE has limited dye penetration compared to solvent-based methods, it avoids quenching of GFP/YFP signals and is well-established for whole plant seedlings like Arabidopsis. This makes it a suitable choice for achieving both deep root imaging and clear cell wall visualization without compromising fluorescence.

**Protocol Steps:**

1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [alpha-bungarotoxin (AChR labeling), Phalloidin (F-actin labeling), Hoechst 33342 (nuclear counterstain)]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is well-established for clearing thick and dense tissues like whole mouse organs, offering strong clearing power and deep penetration of dyes/antibodies. It is compatible with alpha-bungarotoxin and Phalloidin, which are critical for visualizing AChR clusters and F-actin in the neuromuscular junction (NMJ). The use of Hoechst 33342 provides nuclear contrast without interfering with the primary labeling targets. Although uDISCO involves hazardous solvents, it ensures minimal shrinkage and distortion while maintaining structural integrity of the NMJ.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Labeling  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.3 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.5 Incubation with alpha-bungarotoxin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:100 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 2 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.6 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.7 Incubation with Phalloidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.8 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.9 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 dilution in PBS) for 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.10 Wash with PBS for 3 × 15 minutes (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE)) for 3 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% DBE) for 12 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% DBE) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 50% (vol/vol) glycerol in DBE) for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mount the cleared tissue in RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) using a low-viscosity optical mounting medium or coverslip.  
6.2 Store at 4 ℃ in the dark until imaging.  
6.3 Perform imaging using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission settings for Alexa Fluor 488, 568, and Hoechst 33342.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [alpha-bungarotoxin (AChR), Phalloidin (F-actin), DiI (for axonal tracing)]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method that preserves fluorescent signals, including those from organic dyes and fluorescent proteins, while providing strong clearing power for dense tissues like whole muscles. It supports deep penetration of labeling agents, which is critical for visualizing fine structures such as NMJ synapses and axonal skeletons in thick tissue. The use of alpha-bungarotoxin for AChR labeling, Phalloidin for F-actin (to visualize the postsynaptic membrane structure), and DiI for axonal tracing aligns with the scientific goals of assessing NMJ pairing, fragmentation, and nerve coverage without introducing extraneous fluorescent targets.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Fixation
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 24 hours at 4 ℃ (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Labeling
3.1 Incubation with alpha-bungarotoxin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:1000 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 24 hours at 4 ℃ (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with Phalloidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 2 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with DiI (1:1000 dilution in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) for 24 hours at 4 ℃ (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.6 Wash with PBS for 3 × 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Delipidation
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butyl alcohol for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butyl alcohol for 1 hour at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6 Refractive Index Matching
6.1 Incubation with FDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether, DBE) for 12 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
6.2 Incubation with FDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) DBE) for 24 hours at RT (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7 Imaging Preparation
7.1 Mount the cleared tissue in DBE on a glass slide using a coverslip.
7.2 Perform 3D imaging using a light-sheet or confocal microscope with appropriate excitation/emission settings for Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 568, and DiI.

PGP9.5 is a specific marker for pan-neuronal structures, including vagal nerve endings, making it ideal for mapping the fine 3D distribution of gastric wall neurons. Although uDISCO quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, it is compatible with Alexa Fluor 647, which is used here via antibody conjugation. Hoechst 33342 is not recommended due to marker-level cautions for PGP9.5 labeling.

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Blocking and Primary Antibody Incubation  
2.1 Incubation with 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum in PBS with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with anti-PGP9.5 antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 2 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Washing with PBS-Triton X-100 (0.3%) for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

3 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Stain Incubation  
3.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 1 day. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Washing with PBS-Triton X-100 (0.3%) for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  
3.3 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 dilution in PBS) for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Washing with PBS for 3 × 10 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each)  

4 Dehydration and Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (10% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) in DCM) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (20% (vol/vol) DBE in DCM) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (40% (vol/vol) DBE in DCM) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.4 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate (BABB)) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution for an additional 24 hours to ensure full penetration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7.1 Mount the cleared tissue in RI-matching solution within a glass-bottomed dish or custom chamber suitable for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.  
7.2 Ensure no air bubbles are present under the tissue.  
7.3 Perform imaging immediately or store at 4 ℃ in the RI-matching solution for up to 1 week.

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Blocking and Primary Antibody Incubation  
2.1 Incubation with 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum in PBS with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with anti-PGP9.5 antibody (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 2 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Washing with PBS-Triton X-100 (0.3%) for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

3 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Stain Incubation  
3.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 1 day. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Washing with PBS-Triton X-100 (0.3%) for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  
3.3 Incubation with Hoechst 33342 (1:1000 dilution in PBS) for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Washing with PBS for 3 × 10 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each)  

4 Dehydration and Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (10% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) in DCM) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (20% (vol/vol) DBE in DCM) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (40% (vol/vol) DBE in DCM) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.4 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% (vol/vol) DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate (BABB)) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution for an additional 24 hours to ensure full penetration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount the cleared tissue in RI-matching solution within a glass-bottomed dish or custom chamber suitable for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.  
7.2 Ensure no air bubbles are present under the tissue.  
7.3 Perform imaging immediately or store at 4 ℃ in the RI-matching solution for up to 1 week.

**Justification:** uDISCO is well-suited for large and dense tissues like the whole mouse brain and tongue, offering strong clearing power with good antibody/dye penetration. Npas4 and C-Fos are immediate early genes (IEGs) that mark activated neurons, and their detection using specific antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor dyes allows for precise identification of single- and double-positive cells. DAPI is avoided due to marker-level cautions for Npas4 and C-Fos.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization

1.2 Incubation with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 10% normal goat serum (NGS) in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Npas4 (1:500 dilution in 1% NGS/PBS) and anti-C-Fos (1:500 dilution in 1% NGS/PBS) for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-goat IgG (1:500) in 1% NGS/PBS for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

我需要对完整小鼠脑组织和舌头进行整体透明化处理，用于研究麻醉唤醒过程中的舌-脑神经环路。样本包含完整脑组织和舌头，脑组织约 1.5 cm × 1 cm × 0.8 cm，舌头长约 1.5 cm，已完成固定和后固定。科学目标是在特定行为任务后捕捉全脑范围内被激活的神经元，并区分两种不同立即早期基因表达模式，比较 MTN、LC、PVT、NAcSh 等脑区中活化神经元的数量、分布和共表达关系。

我在进行小鼠舌-脑环路透明化实验时遇到问题：固定后直接放入 100% 甲醇脱水 48 小时，然后进行 Alexa Fluor 647 孵育 24 小时，最后直接放入 DBE 透明。结果脑组织仍然不透明，且 Alexa Fluor 647 信号很弱。该流程缺少梯度脱水/复水、充分透化、封闭、长时间抗体渗透、多轮洗涤和温和 RI 匹配，且 100% 甲醇与 DBE 可能造成抗原性下降、组织收缩和荧光减弱。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合完整脑组织和舌头的活动依赖性神经元双标、深层抗体渗透、低背景、荧光保持、均一透明化和三维成像。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 488, Phalloidin (F-Actin) + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is well-suited for large, dense tissues like the whole mouse brain and tongue due to its high clearing power and deep antibody/dye penetration. It allows for robust labeling of Npas4 (an immediate early gene marker for activated neurons) with Alexa Fluor 488, which is compatible with uDISCO. Phalloidin can be used as an auxiliary channel to visualize F-Actin in tongue muscles, aiding in anatomical reference without interfering with the primary activation signal. The method’s solvent-based approach ensures strong tissue clearing while maintaining structural integrity for 3D imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum in PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody against Npas4 (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) × 3 times  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG, 1:500 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) × 3 times  

3 Phalloidin Staining (Tongue Only)  
3.1 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:100 dilution in PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) × 3 times  

4 Dehydration and Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% dibenzyl ether, DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 50% w/v sorbitol in DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Incubation with mounting medium containing 1.51 RI (e.g., 50% w/v sorbitol in DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Mounting on a glass slide with coverslip for light-sheet or confocal imaging.

我需要对小鼠完整脊髓、丘脑和体感皮层进行整体透明化处理，用于研究躯体感觉信息从外周到中枢的传递通路。样本包括约 3 cm 长完整脊髓、约 5 mm × 4 mm × 4 mm 的丘脑和约 1 cm × 0.8 cm × 2 mm 的体感皮层组织，已完成固定和后固定。科学目标是使用两种脂溶性示踪染料追踪不同感觉通路的神经投射，比较它们在脊髓、丘脑和体感皮层中的走行、终末分布和通路分离/重叠关系。

我在进行小鼠脊髓-丘脑-皮层感觉通路透明化实验时遇到问题：固定后直接放入 SDS 清除液中处理 48 小时，然后进行 Alexa Fluor 647 孵育 24 小时，最后放入甘油中。结果组织仍然不透明，且 Alexa Fluor 647 信号分布不均匀。该流程与科学目标不匹配，因为目标是保留并成像 DiI/DiD 脂溶性示踪信号，而不是依赖 Alexa Fluor 抗体孵育；同时 SDS 48 小时和甘油匹配不足以完成长脊髓和脑区组织的均一透明化。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合 DiI/DiD 脂溶性示踪信号保留、长程感觉通路成像、脊髓和脑区组织充分脱水/脱脂、低背景、均一 RI 匹配和三维重建。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with 1× PBS containing 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN3 (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor 647, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is well-suited for high-lipid or high-pigment tissues like scWAT due to its strong clearing power and deep penetration of antibodies and dyes. It allows for the use of Alexa Fluor 647 and 488, which are compatible with the method and suitable for labeling CGRP-positive sensory fibers and PGP9.5-positive sensory fibers. DAPI is avoided as it is cautioned for PGP9.5 labeling. The method’s solvent-based approach ensures efficient tissue clearing while maintaining morphology, making it ideal for 3D imaging of complex structures such as fat lobules, vascular regions, and nerve networks.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Permeabilization  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol containing 0.5% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Immunostaining  
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (1% BSA in PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-CGRP (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) and anti-PGP9.5 (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) repeated 3 times  
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-IgG (1:500 dilution) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-IgG (1:500 dilution) in blocking solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) repeated 3 times  

4 Nucleus Staining  
4.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS with 0.3% Triton X-100) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) repeated 3 times  

5 Delipidation  
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibromoethane (DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

6 Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution (100% DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., 50% w/v sorbitol in DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.51 RI) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Incubation with mounting medium (RI ~1.51, e.g., 50% w/v sorbitol in DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Mounting on a glass slide with coverslip for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization  
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol containing 0.5% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol containing 1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Labeling  
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (1% BSA in 100% methanol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-PGP9.5 (1:200 dilution in 1% BSA/methanol) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200 dilution in 1% BSA/methanol) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution in 1% BSA/methanol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500 dilution in 1% BSA/methanol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.6 Incubation with 1% BSA in 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) to remove unbound antibodies

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 1 (10% (vol/vol) DCM, 10% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE), 80% (vol/vol) PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5.3 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 3 (40% (vol/vol) DCM, 40% (vol/vol) DBE, 20% (vol/vol) PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.4 Incubation with uDISCO clearing solution 4 (100% (vol/vol) DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (1.51 RI, e.g., benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate (BABB)) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with RI matching solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with RI matching solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) RI matching solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour) to ensure complete immersion  
7.2 Mounting in a glass-bottomed dish or custom imaging chamber filled with RI matching solution for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is well-suited for whole mouse brain-sized samples due to its strong clearing power and compatibility with a wide range of fluorescent dyes, including Alexa Fluor 647 (for CD31 immunostaining) and Alexa Fluor 568 (for Lectin labeling of functional vascular lumens). It preserves fluorescence effectively while allowing deep penetration of antibodies and dyes into dense tissue. This method supports the high-resolution 3D imaging required to analyze vascular network morphology, including vessel density, branching, curvature, and perfusion status in both tumor core and periphery.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunostaining  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (1% BSA + 10% normal goat serum in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody against CD31 (1:100 dilution in blocking solution) for 2 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with washing buffer (PBS + 0.1% Tween-20) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG, 1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 1 day. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with washing buffer for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Lectin Staining  
3.1 Incubation with 10 µg/mL Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated Lectin in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with washing buffer for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Nuclear Staining  
4.1 Incubation with 1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS for 10 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with washing buffer for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Dehydration and Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) DBE in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) DBE in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) DBE in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.48 RI, e.g., 1.48 RI glycerol-based solution) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Incubation with 1% (vol/vol) antifade reagent in RI-matching solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Mounting on a glass slide with coverslip using RI-matching solution for light-sheet or confocal imaging.
